KRTL_2026_GENERAL.note: Kentucky Right to Life Victory PAC 2026 General Election PAC Alert (8 image slides, page modified Oct 9 2026, announced Oct 27 2026). Complete for federal, state senate and state house. Designations: ENDORSED, PROLIFE CHAMPION, RECOMMENDED, PREFERRED CANDIDATE, OPPOSED. Unopposed incumbents are listed with no designation and are included here with detail saying so (not endorsements). No Democrat returned the questionnaire. Primary-only guide (Apr 2026 PDF) exists but is not used.
KRTL_2026_GENERAL.value: ENDORSED / PROLIFE CHAMPION = pro-life endorsement (RULES: proLife A). RECOMMENDED / PREFERRED CANDIDATE = weaker pro-life support, not an endorsement. OPPOSED = KRTL opposes. 'Unopposed, no designation' and 'pending' entries carry no signal.
